attributes.action: Stop the rapid expansion of AI data centres in the UK
attributes.additional_details: According to the BBC, there are almost 100 new data centres planned for construction in the next 5 years, with some expected to cover as much as 540,000 square metres. It is no secret that these data centres are contributing to the climate crisis, using massive amounts of water and emitting both air and noise pollution, so we are asking the UK Government to re-prioritise, listen to our communities and put a stop to the construction of these data centres.
attributes.background: This petition is calling on the UK Government to protect our communities and countrysides by stopping big tech firms from building AI data centres on our land.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Ban the construction of new AI data centres" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776517
